rollback_evidence: Used only by the port-bounce operation (1.0.12 eos port maintenance E08): 'shutdown', a pause, then 'no shutdown' on one Ethernet port behind the timed safeguard session of EOS (configure session with commit timer; an expired timer returns the whole running configuration, the port comes up again). Measured on cEOS 4.36.1F: show running-config shows 'shutdown' only while the port is disabled; the check account reads the Status column of show interfaces N status: disabled right after shutdown, connected again right after no shutdown (the link of the lab peer); the log shows LINEPROTO-5-UPDOWN down and up. The time until a physical link is up again is not measured; the operation waits for it with at most 30 s of pauses between reads of the check account and reports the observed state.
